activities.body: Answer from memory in one or two sentences.
activities.concept: Product rule
activities.correctAnswer: Differentiate a product by adding two terms: first function times the derivative of the second, plus the derivative of the first times the second.

activities.concept: Chain rule
activities.correctAnswer: Differentiate a composite function by differentiating the outside part first, then multiplying by the derivative of the inside part.
activities.feedback: A complete answer shows the outer derivative, then the inner derivative as a multiplier. If needed, repair any answer that treats the inside and outside parts as one same derivative.
